query: What learner needs and pain points appear in survey responses?

per_column.name: primary_challenge_domain
per_column.rationale: Identifies the domain in which the learner's challenge/pain point falls (e.g., science_lab, mathematics, participation). This is an aspect OF the needs/pain points -- the 'where' of the difficulty -- and is a legitimate constitutive facet.

per_column.name: engagement_and_motivation_signal
per_column.rationale: Motivational/engagement state is a genuine aspect of learner needs and pain points (loss of interest, disengagement are pain points). Constitutive facet of the affective-motivational dimension.

per_column.name: social_interaction_need
per_column.rationale: Directly names a category of learner need (peer collaboration, group discussion). This is a 'need' aspect OF the concept -- clearly meronymic.

per_column.name: hands_on_material_dependency
per_column.rationale: Captures a material/practical dependency need (manipulatives essential, materials hard at home). A concrete need/pain-point facet.

per_column.name: instructional_quality_signal
per_column.rationale: This describes the quality of teaching provision (teacher responsiveness, teacher overwhelmed) -- an external condition/driver acting ON the learner rather than an aspect OF the learner's own needs. It is a cause/context of pain points, not a constitutive part of them.

per_column.name: modality_alignment_with_learner
per_column.rationale: The fit between delivery modality and the learner (synchronous essential, screen hurts focus) expresses a learner need/pain point regarding format. Borderline but reads as an aspect OF learner needs.

per_column.name: identity_and_confidence_impact
per_column.rationale: Confidence/anxiety/emotional distress are core affective pain points -- an aspect OF the learner's experience. Constitutive facet.

judge.rationale: Most columns are genuine constitutive facets of learner needs and pain points, spanning cognitive/domain, motivational, social, material, modality, and affective/identity dimensions -- good coverage, hence solid exhaustiveness. However, instructional_quality_signal describes the teaching provision quality (an external driver/cause acting on the learner), not an aspect OF the learner's own needs, so it fails the meronymy test. Mutual exclusivity is moderate: engagement_and_motivation and identity_and_confidence overlap on affective state; social_interaction_need overlaps with participation_discussion under primary_challenge_domain; and modality_alignment overlaps conceptually with hands_on_material_dependency (both concern format/delivery fit). These overlaps lower non-overlap of the facet set.
